whyChoose.title: Why Choose Our AI Receptionist?
whyChoose.subtitle: Experience the difference with the market's most advanced AI-powered booking system, designed specifically for Danish businesses

features.title: 24/7 Availability
features.description: Our AI receptionist works around the clock with no breaks, holidays, or days off. Your customers can always book an appointment, whether it's the middle of the night, the weekend, or a public holiday. That means more bookings and higher customer satisfaction.

features.title: Increased Efficiency
features.description: Automate up to 80% of your phone inquiries and free up valuable time for your staff. Drastically reduce administrative tasks and let your team focus on delivering top-class service to your customers.

features.title: Instant Response
features.description: No waiting time for your customers. The AI answers every call instantly and can handle unlimited conversations simultaneously. That means zero missed calls and maximum customer satisfaction at all times.

features.title: Smart Calendar Integration
features.description: Seamless integration with your existing booking system. The AI sees your real calendar in real time and only books available slots. Every appointment is synced automatically with detailed notes on the conversation and the customer's requests.

features.title: Reduce No-Shows
features.description: Automatic reminders via SMS and email reduce missed appointments by up to 65%. The system sends intelligent reminders at the right time and can even rebook automatically in case of cancellations.

features.title: Flawless Danish
features.description: Our AI is trained specifically for the Danish language and Danish cultural norms. It understands dialects and slang and speaks natural Danish. Your customers experience a pleasant, professional conversation every single time.

benefitsSection.title: Concrete Benefits For Your Business

benefits.title: Save 10+ Hours a Week
benefits.description: Free up time that used to go on answering the phone, managing bookings, and sending reminders. Spend that time growing your business instead.

benefits.title: Increase Revenue by 30%
benefits.description: Capture every lead 24/7 and reduce lost bookings. More bookings and fewer no-shows mean a direct increase in revenue.

benefits.title: Zero Missed Calls
benefits.description: Every unanswered call is lost revenue. With the AI receptionist, no call slips through - even when you're busy, in a meeting, or outside opening hours.

benefits.title: Better Customer Experience
benefits.description: Consistently high quality of service every time. No bad days, no stress-induced mistakes. Your customers always experience a professional, friendly receptionist.

benefits.title: Complete Documentation
benefits.description: Every conversation is recorded and transcribed automatically. Gain valuable insight into customer requests, common questions, and opportunities to improve your service.

benefits.title: Scalable Solution
benefits.description: Handle 1 or 1,000 calls a day without hiring more staff. The system grows with your business at no extra cost.
